predicates.title: Storage account allows public blob access
predicates.description: allowBlobPublicAccess is enabled, permitting containers to be set to anonymous access.
predicates.recommendation: Set allowBlobPublicAccess=false at the account level.

query.kql: Resources | where type == 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' | where properties.allowBlobPublicAccess == true | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, allowBlobPublicAccess = properties.allowBlobPublicAccess

predicates.title: Storage account public network access without firewall
predicates.description: publicNetworkAccess is Enabled with default-allow network rules.
predicates.recommendation: Set defaultAction=Deny, add private endpoints, restrict to known networks.

predicates.title: Storage account secure transfer disabled or weak TLS
predicates.description: Secure transfer (HTTPS-only) is disabled or the minimum TLS version is below 1.2.
predicates.attack_vector: Cleartext/downgraded transport -> credential or data interception

predicates.title: Blob container with anonymous access
predicates.description: A container's public access level is Blob or Container, exposing data to the internet.
predicates.recommendation: Set container access to Private; serve data via SAS or authenticated access.
